notes: kb/Work PB5242 landed. §1985:XIII.3.19.4 GR4: the RWCS moves the sum counter "according to the rules of the MOVE statement" to the printable item. ReportWriterEmitter.TransferImage moves it with no rounding, and SumPresentable keeps a 1985 size error from blanking it (kb/Work PB5248). The ROUNDED phrase, which turned the MOVE into a rounded COMPUTE, is a 2002 form refused at 85 (report-sum-forms-2002, VisitReportSumClause). Witnesses: 1985-GR-XIII_3_19_4-4 and pb5242-sum-forms-85. Each 2002 form is refused at --std 85 with COBOL0900 by a construct row of the version matrix (tests/version-matrix/constructs/report-*-2002.json, introducedIn 2002), checked on recognition in VersionConformancePass's parse arm, and accepted from COBOL-2002 (ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115).

next.reason: 1985: "The report writer control system moves the data contained in the sum counter, according to the rules of the MOVE statement"; 2023: "If the associated size error indicator is set, an EC-REPORT-SUM-SIZE exception condition is set to exist and the printable item is filled with spaces.". Both treat the sum counter as a source item moved by MOVE rules. 2023 adds a ROUNDED case computed by COMPUTE rules, and on size error it fills the item with spaces instead of moving.
